players.product: Large-scale water treatment systems for semiconductor makers, plus maintenance, consumables and piping materials for semiconductor manufacturing equipment

quarterly_data.quarter: Nomura Micro Science semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: First half to September 30, 2025 (semi-annual report): orders received JPY 15,538 million (+19.8% YoY), net sales JPY 25,193 million (+39.6%), operating profit JPY 2,861 million (+84.3%), ordinary profit JPY 2,060 million (JPY 59 million a year earlier), net profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 1,413 million (JPY 28 million). Water treatment systems sales JPY 17,397 million (+67.3%) as construction of large water treatment systems already ordered in Japan and the US progressed smoothly; maintenance and consumables JPY 7,381 million (+16.7%) with orders firm mainly from semiconductor-related companies; other businesses JPY 414 million (-68.6%) as sales of piping materials for large semiconductor manufacturing equipment ran their course. Management states capex by semiconductor-related companies, its main customers, remained strong and orders were won steadily, though with regional differences.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 25,193 million (+39.6%); operating profit JPY 2,861 million (+84.3%); orders JPY 15,538 million (+19.8%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nomura Micro Science semi-annual report: H1 FY2026 (11-14-2025)
quarterly_data.signal: Segments, first half to September 2025 (semi-annual report): Japan sales JPY 14,509 million (+62.1%), operating profit JPY 1,800 million (+433.1%), on smooth construction of large domestic water treatment systems already ordered; Korea JPY 2,084 million (+31.0%), operating profit JPY 88 million (-48.8%) as cost of sales and SG&A rose; China JPY 2,734 million (-32.1%), operating loss JPY 98 million (operating profit JPY 374 million a year earlier), as large water treatment projects ran their course; Taiwan JPY 1,273 million (-32.7%), operating profit JPY 433 million (-25.6%), likewise; US JPY 4,585 million (+189.9%), operating profit JPY 650 million (+670.0%), on smooth construction of large water treatment systems already ordered; Other (Singapore subsidiary, operating from this half) sales JPY 6 million, operating loss JPY 13 million. Group R&D spending in the half was JPY 194 million.
quarterly_data.figure: US JPY 4,585 million (+189.9%); Japan JPY 14,509 million (+62.1%); R&D JPY 194 million
